## Problem

What problem or gap does this address? Is it related to an existing Argo
package, an experiment result, or the argo model itself?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see. If this proposes a new Argo package, note
its intended Destination (the reusable class of outcome it targets).

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Additional context

Links to relevant discussion, prior experiments, or documentation.
